text:
maria: quick heads-up — we saw a burst of 429s hitting redwood-alpha-1 in us-west-2 around 14:12. latency was fine but queue depth maxed.
raj: ugh. is that the primary model for many tiers? which variant did it try next?
maria: traffic was sticky to alpha-1 (default). current router does simple compatible-variant spill, but capacity signal only triggers a rejection, not an automatic reroute.
sam: thought we had an autofailover? iirc it only kicks in for hard OOMs, not saturations that return 429s.
evan: correct. we treat 429 as transient and prefer throttling. ops-bot pointed out customers were seeing degraded UX instead of silent fallback.
maria: proposal: automatic variant fallback on sustained capacity signals (rolling 30s error rate > 5% OR queue depth > 90%). fallback should prefer region-local compatible quantized variant (alpha-1-q4) with a gradual probe back to primary.
raj: +1 but we need tenant tier rules. don't spill enterprise to q4 by default unless they opted in. maybe a tenant flag: fallback_policy: [always|tiered|never]
sam: agree. default for free/org tiers -> tiered, enterprise -> never unless account_opt_in=true. Also a per-route header to override: X-RW-Fallback: allow|probe-only|deny
maria: rough router config snippet:
```
route("/generate") {
  fallback_rules: [
    {signal: "sustained_capacity", to_variant: "alpha-1-q4", weight:0.8, probe_interval: 30s},
  ]
  tenant_policy: {
    default: "tiered",
    overrides: {"enterprise": "never"}
  }
}
```
evan: telemetry needs to be explicit. emit events: fallback.attempt, fallback.success, fallback.revert, fallback.reason, fallback.latency_overhead_ms, fallback.sticky_duration_ms.
sam: add fields for from_model/to_model, tenant_id, route, request_count, tokens_consumed. we also need a console view: per-tenant fallback counts, recent failures, %requests spilled, and a timeline of probe successes.
raj: UI/ops ask: show top impacted routes and list of customers who hit fallback spikes so CSE can reach out. privacy filter to avoid raw prompts.
maria: also adjust billing tokens when falling to q4? cost/unit differs. telemetry should tie to cost delta and show estimated savings vs degradation.
evan: rollout UX: default rollout in console should be "dry-run" where fallback is simulated and logged (still 429 the request) for 24h, then can be enabled with a global switch + tenant whitelist.
sam: implement header for SDKs to opt-in now: `X-RW-Fallback: allow` — SDKs can set per-request if they trade quality for latency.
maria: ops-bot scheduled a safety: if fallback rate > 30% globally, disable autofallback cluster-wide and page oncall.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/auto-fallback-router -> staging in 12m :rocket:
raj: tests: add e2e that simulates slow token loop and asserts router reroutes within 30s and sticky backoff works.
maria: let's capture open todo: (1) tenant policy defaults (2) header name + semantics (3) telemetry event schema (4) console widgets (5) billing adjustments (6) rollout dry-run flow
sam: i'll draft a short RFC and include the event contract. ping @oncall once we have the kill-switch hook.
evan: sounds good. :+1:
maria: thanks all — i'll start RFC draft and link it here in an hour. :eyes:
